description: The PORT RUNTIME copied into every translated Godot project: its InputManager and deterministic random stream, imperative Control store, R3F/Pixi scheduler that brackets input before translated process callbacks, shared SceneTree lifecycle traversal, mounted-world/audio/physics slots, source-equivalent postprocessing passes, shared native assembly for inert prefab-preview contexts, and static debug/system declaration used by the current observation door. It is separate from godot-compat because compat binds Godot-shaped calls to native library objects and owns no scheduler or project singleton, while this capability owns the port's mounted machinery. Module scope is project scope under the copied-capability model. The translator emits only project-specific actions, effect/resource/autoload/Control literals, scene structure, and lifecycle bindings that attach that scene to these exports; it never synthesizes this shared executable behavior.
title: Godot port runtime (mounted machinery of a ported game)
